claims: YouTube is raising U.S. Premium prices for the first time since 2023.
YouTube U.S. Premium individual plans are rising by $2 to $15.99 per month.
YouTube U.S. Premium family plans are increasing by $4 to $26.99 per month.
The price hikes for Lite ($8.99/mo) and Student ($8.99/mo) plans are effective immediately for new users.
Existing subscribers will see YouTube Premium changes in June 2026.
U.S. Individual Premium price is $15.99 per month.
U.S. Individual Premium previous price was $13.99 per month.
U.S. Family Plan price is $26.99 per month.
U.S. Family Plan previous price was $22.99 per month.
U.S. Premium Lite price is $8.99 per month.
U.S. Premium Lite previous price was $7.99 per month.
U.S. Student Plan price is $8.99 per month.
U.S. Student Plan previous price was $7.99 per month.
U.S. Music Premium price is $11.99 per month.
U.S. Music Premium previous price was $10.99 per month.
U.S. Annual Plan price is $159.99 per year.
U.S. Annual Plan previous price was $139.99 per year.
New prices are live for new YouTube Premium subscribers.
New YouTube Premium prices will begin in the June 2026 billing cycle for existing members.
Existing YouTube Premium members will receive 30-day notice emails.
YouTube stated the increase supports improvements to the service and compensates creators.
Netflix had 2026 price hikes.
Hulu had 2026 price hikes.
2026 price hikes in the streaming industry are often called "streamflation".
